game.title: Aliens vs. Predator
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Rebellion (RAWG also lists SEGA), published by SEGA, released 2010-02-16. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes: three campaigns (Marine, Alien, Predator), harder difficulties, collectibles, weapon feats and multiplayer.

chapters.title: Marine Campaign
chapters.summary: The Marine story: surviving the party at the Club, escaping C-Block, helping Van Zandt, finding Tequila and recovering a datapad. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Alien Campaign
chapters.summary: The Alien story: escaping the Research Lab, hunting Marines in the Colony, the riddle of the Ruins and harvesting civilians. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Predator Campaign
chapters.summary: The Predator story: through Gateway and the Jungle, an ancient mask, trial by combat, the Research Lab and the artifacts. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Hard, Nightmare and Full Completion
chapters.summary: Finishing all three campaigns, each campaign on Hard and on Nightmare, and every achievement.

chapters.title: Audio Diaries, Royal Jelly and Trophy Belts
chapters.summary: The 67 Marine Audio Diaries, the 50 Royal Jelly Containers and the 45 Predator trophy belts.

chapters.title: Weapon Feats
chapters.summary: Multi-kills and kill counts with the shotgun, Battle Disc, smartgun, scoped rifle, Combi Stick and pistol.

chapters.title: Ranked Matches and Survivor
chapters.summary: Ranked Deathmatch and Infestation, XP goals, playing with friends, and the Survivor mode. Needs a network connection, if the servers still run.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Aliens_vs._Predator
Fandom (avp.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://avp.fandom.com/wiki/Aliens_vs._Predator_(2010_video_game)
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected 2010 entry (id 39277, slug aliens-vs-predator-3, released 2010-02-16); the second result is the 1999 "Aliens Versus Predator" (id 30261), which was not used. Steam app 10680 ("Aliens vs. Predator™") is the only store-list match; its schema is named "ValveTestApp10680" (no codename). 50 Steam achievements, none hidden; the first global-percentage request failed with an HTTP 500 and a retry worked. The campaign chapters follow the Steam internal achievement names (MARINE_1 to MARINE_8, ALIEN_1 to ALIEN_6, PREDATOR_1 to PREDATOR_8), assigned by name rules in Steam's order; whether those numbers are the mission order is not confirmed. Whether the weapon-feat achievements are single-player or multiplayer is not stated, so they have their own chapter. StrategyWiki has the guide under "Aliens vs. Predator" ("Aliens vs. Predator (2010)" redirects there) at completion stage 1. Written subpages: Achievements and trophies (about 7,800 characters), Controls (about 2,800), Table of Contents (about 1,500), Weapons (about 1,500) and Gameplay (about 1,000). Walkthrough, Marines, Aliens, Predators, every level page (Colony, Refinery, Jungle, Ruins, Pyramid, Research Lab and their Marine or Predator variants, Research Lab Escape), Maps, Modes and Skins are linked but not written, so it was not used as a walkthrough. avp.fandom.com redirects "Aliens vs. Predator (2010)" to "Aliens vs. Predator (2010 video game)", with about 152 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
